headline: Your codebase. Compressed. Ready to hand off.
subheadline: Stop wasting tokens re-explaining your project. TokenCap snapshots your workspace — files, Git context, imports, and developer intent — into a single handoff-ready file.
description: TokenCap is a local-first developer tool that generates structured, AI-ready snapshots of your codebase. Works offline. Never uploads your code. Runs from the CLI or VS Code.

keyBenefits.label: Local-first
keyBenefits.description: Runs entirely on your machine. No cloud. No uploads. Your code never leaves your workspace.

keyBenefits.label: AI-ready output
keyBenefits.description: Generates structured Markdown snapshots sized for any LLM context window — from llama-3-8b to Gemini 1.5 Pro.

keyBenefits.label: Git-aware
keyBenefits.description: Automatically surfaces changed files, staged and unstaged diffs, recent commits, and branch context.

keyBenefits.label: Privacy-first
keyBenefits.description: Built-in secret redaction strips API keys, tokens, and passwords before anything is written to disk.

keyBenefits.label: Zero configuration
keyBenefits.description: Works out of the box. One command generates everything. Customize with a single JSON config file when you're ready.

keyBenefits.label: VS Code native
keyBenefits.description: Auto-captures on every file save. Status bar indicator. One-click command menu. No workflow disruption.
